notes.text: Yochanan ben Maraya adduces Joshua’s altar for the rule concerning a prophet authorizing a private altar.
The checked digital edition locates Rav Yochanan bar Maraya at 7:9:7 discussing the conjunction in the passages about fins and scales. Preserve Heilprin’s own halakhah number.
Rabbi Yochanan bar Maria transmits in Rabbi Yochanan’s name on the comparative value of charity and deeds of kindness.
Rabbi Yochanan bar Maraya reports Rabbi Pinchas’s inference from the treatment of shoes under the Temple Mount gate.
The altar prooftext parallel expressly gives Yochanan bar Mari. Preserve Heilprin’s ben Mari in his notice and the comparator’s bar Mari in the evidence.
The two witnesses attach the same altar prooftext to differing name forms. The source names are retained within their respective witnesses.
